messages:
Anna K: planning a small tilt in ap-southeast (asia) to route 5% -> new edge pool (edge-asia-2) at 09:30 PDT today. Deploy owner @Matt R. Quick checks: drop DNS TTL, prewarm, smoke curl, validate KV cache hit, rollback readiness. who can own rollback?
Matt R: I'll run the deploy, +1. Plan: 09:15 lower TTL to 60s, 09:25 prewarm, 09:30 shift 5% -> 25% over 10m, 09:45 observe. If all good, step to 50% at 10:00. Rollback is simple weight revert. I'll post the commands now.
Liam C: oncall here, available 09:00-11:00. I can watch metrics. Which dashboards should I watch? any synthetic heatmap or spike panels?
Sophia P: watch route-level p50/p95 latency, request error rate, and backend queue depth. console dash: /dash/edge/asia-tilt . Also confirm function-calling fallbacks are set to stable variants (we had a fallback flip last week).
Matt R: Rollback commands:
```
# revert weights
rbctl set-weight --region asia --from edge-asia-2 --to edge-asia-1 --weight 0.0
# restore TTL
rgdns set-ttl edge-asia.example.com 300
```
Anna K: smoke command (post-tilt):
```
curl -s -H \"Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API\" \"https://edge-asia.example.com/health?route=chat\" | jq .status
```
deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled by Matt R at 2026-03-17T16:30:00Z -> job/edge-tilt-2134567000 queued :rocket:
Matt R: I'll lower TTL and prewarm at 09:15 PDT. Prewarm script:
```
./prewarm.sh --pool edge-asia-2 --rps 50 --duration 300
```
Sophia P: +1 for the smoke steps. add KV cache warm check: `kv-store:hit_ratio` should be >0.6 after prewarm. also ensure healthprobe TTLs are honored by the LB.
Liam C: i'll run simulated traffic (rps sweep) and watch SLOs. ping me right before the tilt (09:29).
Anna K: +1. Escalation threshold: if error rate spikes >2x baseline or p95 increases >150ms for >3m, rollback immediately. anyone want to be primary in-air during the tilt?
Matt R: i'm primary. liam secondary. i'll post a comment when the shift starts and when each step completes. :thumbsup:
Liam C: noted. ready to act.
Anna K: thanks team — will collect the short post-check notes after the window and drop them in #eng-platform for the rollout record.
